status: PROPOSED budgets, re-baselined 2026-10-24 per route: each route's budget is its measured size plus about 1.5 kB, rounded up to the next 0.5 kB ("routes" map); a group's maxGzipKb is only the fallback for a route without its own entry. Still pending client approval (Q-012, NFR-002). Earlier: group budgets about 5 percent above the 2026-10-16 build, which the analytics consent chunk (P7-01) then used up, and group budgets that left 12 to 16 kB of slack on the smaller routes (code review m-8). Rule: a feature that needs more than the headroom must split code, or justify the increase and re-baseline with a recorded decision. See docs/testing/PERFORMANCE.md.
unit: kB of gzip (level 9) JavaScript needed to start the route on a cold load, entry and root included. "routes" overrides the group's maxGzipKb for the named route.
